spans.s:
उख r. 1st cl. (ओखति) (इ) उखि (उंखति) 1. To go, to move or approach.
2. To dry, to wither.
 3. To adorn. The first retains the diphthong
with a prefix ending in अ, as प्र and ओखति make प्रोखति.

उखा f. (-खा) A pot or saucepan, &c.
 E. उख् to go, क affix, and टाप्,
also उघा.
उखर्व्वल m. (-लः) A kind of grass, a sort of Andropogon.
उखल m. (-लः) A kind of grass, a sort of Andropogon.
